title: Spicy Edamame and Crispy Tempeh Buddha Bowl
description: This spicy edamame and crispy tempeh Buddha bowl delivers 24g of protein per serving and comes together in just 25 minutes. Packed with fresh vegetables, grains, and bold flavors, it makes an ideal lunch or post-workout meal. Save it for your next meal prep.
steps: Whisk 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil, and sriracha in a small bowl, then toss the tempeh cubes in the mixture until evenly coated.
Heat a 12-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes. Add the coated tempeh and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides and crispy.
In a separate small saucepan, combine the shelled edamame with 2 tablespoons of water, cover, and steam over medium-low heat for 3 minutes until tender and hot.
In a small bowl, whisk together the remaining 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1/2 tablespoon sesame oil, rice vinegar, and minced ginger to create the bowl dressing.
Divide the warm cooked jasmine rice evenly among 4 bowls as the base.
Top each bowl of rice with the crispy tempeh, steamed edamame, shredded purple cabbage, and julienned carrots.
Drizzle the ginger-soy dressing over each bowl and serve immediately with an extra dash of sriracha if desired.
tips: Substitute quinoa or brown rice for jasmine rice to boost fiber and protein further.
Store leftover components in airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.
Reheat the tempeh and rice in a skillet or microwave before assembling fresh bowls.
storage: Store in airtight containers in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Keep dressing separate until ready to eat.

video_script.hook: Make this spicy edamame and crispy tempeh bowl with 24 grams of protein.
steps_short: Toss cubed tempeh in soy sauce, sesame oil, and sriracha.
Sear the tempeh in a skillet for 8 minutes until crispy.
Steam the edamame for 3 minutes until tender and hot.
Whisk together the soy, ginger, and rice vinegar dressing.
Assemble the bowls with rice, tempeh, edamame, and fresh vegetables.
